translated_title: Authorities Seize 59 Homemade Explosives on Bus Bound for CNTE Solidarity March
original_title: Aseguran 59 explosivos en autobús rumbo a marcha de apoyo a CNTE
author: Fernanda Monroy
meta_description: Federal and Mexico City authorities seized 59 homemade explosives on a bus carrying students and teachers to a CNTE solidarity march, the Interior Ministry says.
